tools.name: stackkit_assess_capacity
tools.title: Assess capacity for a CUE-bound module selection
tools.description: Resolves the same StackSpec and Inventory as /api/v2/resolve, then reports advisory numeric demand through the shared capacity engine. Missing facts stay unverified. The result is bound to the plan hash; it does not attest a host or authorize Apply. The resolver's body, nesting, collection and concurrency limits apply unchanged.

additionalProperties.description: Opaque, time-bound external custody attestation for one exact backup target requirement; provider, endpoint, bucket, credential, and lease fields are structurally excluded.

validUntil.description: Must be after issuedAt and no more than 24 hours later.

externalBackupTargetBindings.description: Optional externally issued Cloud backup target bindings, keyed by Cloud Site and offsite-object-backup capability.

additionalProperties.description: Opaque, time-bound attestation for one exact Federation link requirement; operational fabric details are excluded.

validUntil.description: Must be after issuedAt and no more than 24 hours later.

externalFederationLinkBindings.description: Optional opaque Modern Federation link bindings keyed by inter-site-link.

additionalProperties.description: Opaque external realization of one exact HomeAccessRequirement. The contract intentionally excludes transport, endpoint, address, secret, provider-resource, account, region, and lifecycle fields.

externalHomeAccessBindings.description: Optional externally issued Home access bindings, keyed first by Home Site and then by the exact access capability.

additionalProperties.description: Opaque maximum-24-hour external custody attestation for one exact Home backup requirement. Provider, target topology, endpoint, credential, resource, lease, lifecycle, transport, address, and discovery fields are structurally excluded.

validUntil.description: Must be after issuedAt and no more than 24 hours later.

externalHomeBackupTargetBindings.description: Optional opaque Home encrypted-backup target bindings, keyed by Home Site and encrypted-offsite-backup capability.

externalHostBinding.description: Opaque, hash-bound handoff for an already supplied host. This contract grants an execution channel but no authority to provision, resize, snapshot, delete, or otherwise manage a server-provider resource.

validUntil.description: Must be after issuedAt and no more than 24 hours later.

hostConformanceReceipt.description: StackKits-owned, hash-bound evidence for one ExternalHostBinding. It records OS support and host diagnostics, never provider compatibility or infrastructure lifecycle state.

facts.description: OS compatibility facts plus provider-neutral host diagnostics. Only the OS tuple is a StackKits compatibility claim.

socketPath.description: Canonical absolute Unix-domain socket path using portable ASCII path segments and a .sock suffix. Empty, dot, dot-dot, repeated, backslash, whitespace, control-character, and trailing-slash segments are forbidden. The 107-character bound is also the exact UTF-8 byte bound because the pattern is ASCII-only, leaving Linux sockaddr_un space for the NUL byte.

runtimeDaemons.description: Observed node-scoped runtime daemons keyed by stable daemonRef. CUE additionally requires instanceRef and socketPath uniqueness per node.

backupPolicy.description: Closed provider-free backup intent. Runtime target custody and job, repository, retention, and restore execution remain separate governed authorities. The grant is a ceiling from the subscription; coverage selects the data classes within it and never exceeds it.

coverage.description: Nested coverage group: config, content (config plus the data a stack produces) or media (content plus photo and large-media libraries).

grant.description: Ceiling one subscription grants one stack for coverage, cadence and retention. Every field defaults to the contract maximum; a tier's default values are never restated here.

coverage.description: Nested coverage group: config, content (config plus the data a stack produces) or media (content plus photo and large-media libraries).

driftPolicy.description: Closed provider-free drift observation intent. It grants no read channel, executor, reconciliation, provider, endpoint, credential, command, or host authority.

evidence.description: Evidence is required exactly when drift observation is enabled.

computeTier.description: Declared kit module graph. Not install.mode, placement.mode, hardware.profile, or legacy context. Default standard is the current kit graph; low and high fail closed until the kit declares them. Init and Unifier write this; Apply does not select it; inventory does not rewrite it.

lanDiscovery.description: Explicit allowlist of local Home routes that may be advertised on the LAN. An absent or empty list never infers advertisements from routes.

items.description: Provider-neutral logical node intent. Host identity, connection details, addresses, and server lifecycle are supplied only through an opaque ExternalHostBinding after the intent is normalized.

notifications.description: Owner notification intent. Channels follow the canonical NotificationChannelV1 CUE contract; credentials are secret:// references resolved through local custody. Omitted means no channel.

observability.description: Per-node OTLP collection intent only. Backend selection, retention, dashboards, credentials, headers, and CA material are deliberately excluded.

items.description: Provider-neutral placement intent. A site identifies trust and failure domains; it never identifies a server provider, account, region, datacenter, native resource, credential, or management address.

oneOf.description:
Lossless legacy StackSpec v1 input accepted only to produce migration
diagnostics. Fields are deliberately not projected or discarded at the
HTTP boundary, and this branch can never match a StackSpec v2 header.

tools.name: stackkit_log_get
tools.title: Get deploy log by run ID
tools.description: Returns events from a specific deploy log run. Use query parameters to filter by level or event prefix.

prefix.description: Filter events by message prefix (e.g., apply., decision., tofu.)

tools.name: stackkit_logs_list
tools.title: List all deploy log runs
tools.description: Returns a paginated list of deploy log runs sorted by timestamp.

tools.name: stackkit_status
tools.title: Read node-local StackKit rollout status
tools.description: Read-only status. Native v0.7 validates the local StackSpec v2 and reports spec-only/resolve-required state without claiming operational readiness. Exact v0.6 retains legacy rollout status fields.
